service.description: Titles for the record folders of a records drive listing (recordList of {recordEntityName, recordId}): the record's name (a party's name, else its request, task, order, product, facility, asset or other name field, else its id), its BOSS link and icon (ironstone.commons.PaletteServices.get#RecordLink). One find per entity for all its ids, under the user's filters: no visibility check per record, as FileServices answered only the records the user may see (check#RecordPaths through the STRT_RECORD_VISIBLE_SERVICE hook). idField is the folder map's (else the entity's primary key). A record not found here keeps its id as its title. nameMap is recordEntityName, a new line and recordId to {title, url, icon}.

The kind of a file by its name, as FileServices names it (image, video, audio, pdf, spreadsheet, presentation, document, archive, text, other; folder for a folder), with the icon the screens show for it.

actions.script: const text = String(name || '') const ext = text.includes('.') ? text.slice(text.lastIndexOf('.') + 1).toLowerCase() : '' const contentType = isDirectory ? '' : (ec.resource.contentTypeOf(text) || '') if (isDirectory) fileType = 'folder' else if (contentType.startsWith('image/')) fileType = 'image' else if (contentType.startsWith('video/')) fileType = 'video' else if (contentType.startsWith('audio/')) fileType = 'audio' else if (ext === 'pdf') fileType = 'pdf' else if (['xls', 'xlsx', 'ods', 'csv'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'spreadsheet' else if (['ppt', 'pptx', 'odp'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'presentation' else if (['doc', 'docx', 'odt', 'rtf'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'document' else if (['zip', 'gz', 'tgz', 'bz2', 'xz', '7z', 'rar', 'tar'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'archive' else if (contentType.startsWith('text/') || ['md', 'txt', 'json', 'xml', 'yaml', 'yml'].includes(ext)) fileType = 'text' else fileType = 'other' const icons = {folder: 'sym_o_folder', image: 'sym_o_image', video: 'sym_o_movie', audio: 'sym_o_music_note', pdf: 'sym_o_picture_as_pdf', spreadsheet: 'sym_o_table_chart', presentation: 'sym_o_slideshow', document: 'sym_o_article', archive: 'sym_o_folder_zip', text: 'sym_o_description', other: 'sym_o_draft'} icon = icons[fileType]

service.description: Where a record's files are in the records drive: the drive, its root, the record's own folder (the mapped folder of the record's entity with the record id below it; for a pattern such as asset/*/maintenance the folder is read from one of the record's file locations) and, for each location of locationList under the drive's root, its path in the drive. Nothing when no records drive maps the entity. The caller has checked that the user may see the record.

The rail of Files: the drives the user may open (FileServices.get#UserDrives, without sizes: the personal drive first, then the shared drives and mirrors, the records drive apart), the tags the user sees, the shares waiting for an answer, and whether the user is an administrator (mirrors). The storage of the open drive is asked when the rail shows it (the screen's usage transition, FileServices.get#DriveUsage), as sizing a drive reads every file.

A folder of a drive for the browser: FileServices.list#Folder, which on the records drive lists only the records the user may see and of a mapped folder's record folders the newest limit (hiddenCount: how many more there are, to open by search or from the record); each record folder is named by its record's title (get#RecordNames). Inside a record's folder (folder.recordList, innermost first) its content_ folders (one per *Content row, as Mantle's save#*ContentFile writes them) are opened, so the record's files show at once, with the description and type of their content row, and record is the record with its title and link. In a folder shared with the user (not a member) the breadcrumbs start at the shared folder.

The rows of a fixed view of the browser: recent (find#Recent), favorites (get#Favorites), shared (shares made to the user, not declined), sharedByMe (the user's shares and links), tag (find#Resources by tagId, a tag the user sees), search (find#Resources by text with the type, period and person filters, in one drive and folder when driveId is given) and trash (list#Trash of driveId). FileServices leaves out the rows of records the user may not see. Each row has driveId, driveName, path, name, isDirectory, size, modified, fileType and icon where the source has them.

One file or folder for the details pane: FileServices.get#ResourceInfo with its favorite, tags and shared mark (from its folder's list when the user may read the folder), the user's level on it, the drive with its storage, the shares and links of the item (the user's, or all of them for a manager of the drive), and the record of a records drive path.

Which of the files about to be uploaded into a folder (nameList: names, or paths below the folder for a folder upload) are there already, for the replace, keep both or skip question before the upload.

Upload files into a folder as one change set (FileServices.upload#Resource): contentFile is one uploaded file or a list, relativePath (one or a list, in the same order) the path of each below the folder for a folder upload; conflictPolicy replace, keepBoth or skip for a name already there; an optional version note. message counts what happened.
A new text or markdown file in a folder (FileServices.save#Text), refused when something by that name is there; or with replace an edit of a text file, as a new version with its note.

parameter.name: path
parameter.description: The folder of a new file, or the file itself to edit (with replace)

service.description: The whole text of a text file to edit (at most 2 MB), through FileServices.get#ResourceInfo; refused for a binary file.

Share a file or folder (FileServices.share#Resource): with a user (shareWith user:userId) or a user group (group:userGroupId) with RspView, RspEdit or RspUpload, or by link (isLink Y) with a label, password and expiry, whose token comes back once (linkPath /s/token). A user or the members of a group are told on the FileShare topic, with a link to the item in Files; a notification that cannot be sent is logged and the share stays.

The people and groups of the share dialog: active users with a party whose name or username has the term (user:userId) and the user groups whose name or id has it (group:userGroupId), as [{value, label, kind}].
The user's recent files for Commons Home (FileServices.find#Recent, without records the user may not see): name, drive, folder, when, by, type and icon, and the link that opens the file in Files.

The palette's Files group (a palette-source of Commons): files and folders by name across the drives the user may open (FileServices.find#Resources), without records the user may not see, each to its place in Files.

The drives screen: every drive the user may open, archived ones too (FileServices.get#UserDrives), with the user's level, storage, members, used of quota (includeUsage; FileServices leaves the records drive unsized, a walk of every record's files) and the last fetch of a mirror; and whether the user may add a mirror (administrators).

A new shared drive of the user (FileServices.create#Drive): storage folder, gitDb or gitLocal, or for an administrator mirror (a read-only drive over remoteUrl); a quota in MB; the members (user ids, one list or comma text) with one permission.
One drive's settings page: the drive with its storage and repository (FileServices.get#DriveAccess), the user's level, and its members with their names (get#DriveMembers).

actions.script: isAdmin = ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') memberList = [] const access = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.FileServices.get#DriveAccess').parameter('driveId', driveId).call() if (!access.drive || access.level < 1) { ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Drive not found')); return } drive = access.drive level = access.level isOwner = access.isOwner const owner = drive.ownerUserId ? ec.entity.find('moqui.security.UserAccount').condition('userId', drive.ownerUserId).useCache(true).disableAuthz().one() : null ownerName = owner ? (owner.userFullName || owner.username) : null if (drive.driveKindEnumId === 'RdkPersonal' || drive.driveKindEnumId === 'RdkRecords') return const LEVEL = {RdpView: 'View', RdpEdit: 'Edit', RdpManage: 'Manage'} memberList = Array.from(ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.FileServices.get#DriveMembers').parameter('driveId', driveId).call().memberList || []) .map((member) => Object.assign({}, member, {permissionLabel: ec.l10n.localize(LEVEL[member.permissionEnumId] || 'View'), kind: member.userId ? 'user' : 'group'}))

service.description: The shares screen: what is shared with the user (waiting for an answer first), what the user shared with people, and the user's links (FileServices.get#Shares), each with its drive's name and a link into Files.
